correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed binary Stern doubling recurrences in GF(2)[X]/Phi_p, where 2 is primitive modulo each listed p. Trace of primitive p-th root xi to F2 is 1, so T^2+T+xi irreducible over GF(2^(p-1)); roots alpha,beta are q-conjugate and rho=alpha/beta has order dividing Q=q+1. A_n(xi)=alpha^n+beta^n yields the all-n equivalence to rho^n=1. Independent exact GF(2) polynomial arithmetic verified each complete factorization of Q and the 22 nonzero tests A_(Q/r)(xi), forcing rho to have full order Q for all nine p; reduction modulo two handles both integer signs. The computation is a finite certificate at nine p, not a scan of all n.

The exact possible reduction to Dickson/characteristic-two traces is considered. Unindexed or post-2014 resolution remains possible.
